45:create table public.organizations (
46-  id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
47-  name       text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
48-  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
49-);
50-alter table public.organizations enable row level security;
51-
52--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
53--- memberships: staff and managers. unique (user_id) = a staff member or manager
54--- belongs to exactly one organization (the brief's rule, enforced by the DB).
55--- Roles come from here, never from user_metadata.
56--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
57:create table public.memberships (
58-  id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
59-  user_id    uuid not null unique,  -- auth.users.id (no FK: see note at top)
60-  org_id     uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
61-  role       text not null check (role in ('manager', 'staff')),
62-  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
63-);
64-create index memberships_org_id_idx on public.memberships (org_id);
65-alter table public.memberships enable row level security;
66-
67--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
68--- units
69--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
70:create table public.units (
71-  id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
72-  org_id     uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
73-  name       text not null check (char_length(btrim(name)) > 0),
74-  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
75-  unique (org_id, name),
76-  -- Target of the composite FK from leases. id is first so this index also
77-  -- serves plain lookups by id (it is the selective column).
78-  unique (id, org_id)
79-);
80-alter table public.units enable row level security;
81-
82--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
83--- tenants: a renter, scoped to one organization. user_id links the auth account
84--- (nullable: a tenant record can exist before it has a login). unique (user_id)
85--- means one login is one tenant row, so a tenant also sees exactly one org.
86--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
87:create table public.tenants (
88-  id         uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
89-  org_id     uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
90-  user_id    uuid unique,           -- auth.users.id (no FK: see note at top)
91-  full_name  text not null check (char_length(btrim(full_name)) > 0),
92-  email      text not null check (position('@' in email) > 1),
93-  -- Tenants edit this themselves through the Data API, so the format is checked
94-  -- here, not only in the UI: optional +, then digits, spaces or dashes.
95-  phone      text check (phone ~ '^\+?[0-9][0-9 -]{6,19}$'),
96-  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
97-  unique (id, org_id)
98-);
99-create index tenants_org_id_idx on public.tenants (org_id);
100-alter table public.tenants enable row level security;
101-
102--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
103--- leases. Both dates are inclusive (end_date is the tenant's last day).
104--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
105:create table public.leases (
106-  id               uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
107-  org_id           uuid not null references public.organizations (id),
108-  unit_id          uuid not null,
109-  tenant_id        uuid not null,
110-  start_date       date not null,
111-  end_date         date not null,
112-  monthly_rent_sen bigint not null check (monthly_rent_sen > 0),
113-  deposit_sen      bigint not null check (deposit_sen >= 0),
114-  -- auth user who created it. Deliberately no FK: it is a historical fact that
115-  -- must survive the user being deleted (same for recorded_by, decided_by...).
116-  created_by       uuid,
117-  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
118-  check (end_date >= start_date),
119-  -- The unit and the tenant must belong to the lease's own organization.
120-  foreign key (unit_id, org_id) references public.units (id, org_id),
121-  foreign key (tenant_id, org_id) references public.tenants (id, org_id),
122-  unique (id, org_id),
123-  -- No two leases on the same unit overlap. '[]' = both bounds inclusive.
124-  -- An exclusion constraint is checked by the index itself, so two concurrent
125-  -- inserts cannot both succeed (the second waits, then fails with 23P01) —
126-  -- a "select overlapping then insert" check in the app could not promise that.
127-  constraint leases_no_overlap exclude using gist (
128-    unit_id with =,
129-    daterange(start_date, end_date, '[]') with &&
130-  )
142:create table public.invoices (
143-  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
144-  org_id       uuid not null,
145-  lease_id     uuid not null,
146-  kind         text not null check (kind in ('deposit', 'rent')),
147-  period_index integer,
148-  period_start date,
149-  period_end   date,          -- inclusive
150-  due_date     date not null,
151-  -- >= 0, not > 0: a prorated last period of one day can round to 0 sen.
152-  amount_sen   bigint not null check (amount_sen >= 0),
153-  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
154-  constraint invoices_period_shape check (
155-    (kind = 'deposit' and period_index is null and period_start is null and period_end is null)
156-    or
157-    (kind = 'rent' and period_index >= 0 and period_start is not null
158-      and period_end >= period_start and due_date = period_start)
159-  ),
160-  foreign key (lease_id, org_id) references public.leases (id, org_id),
161-  unique (id, org_id),
162-  -- One rent invoice per period AND at most one deposit per lease: the deposit
163-  -- is the row whose period_index is NULL, and NULLS NOT DISTINCT makes a
164-  -- second NULL for the same lease a duplicate. (A partial unique index
165-  -- `where kind = 'deposit'` would say the same, but Prisma introspects it as
166-  -- lease_id being unique and generates a wrong one-to-one relation.)
167-  constraint invoices_lease_id_period_index_key
185:create table public.gateway_bills (
186-  id             text primary key
187-                   default 'bill_' || replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', '')
188-                   check (id ~ '^bill_[0-9a-f]{32}$'),
189-  org_id         uuid not null,
190-  lease_id       uuid not null,
191-  amount_sen     bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
192-  status         text not null default 'pending'
193-                   check (status in ('pending', 'paid', 'failed')),
194-  transaction_id text,
195-  paid_at        timestamptz,
196-  created_by     uuid,
197-  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
198-  updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
199-  check (status <> 'paid' or paid_at is not null),
200-  foreign key (lease_id, org_id) references public.leases (id, org_id)
201-);
202-create index gateway_bills_lease_id_org_id_idx on public.gateway_bills (lease_id, org_id);
203-create index gateway_bills_org_id_idx on public.gateway_bills (org_id);
204-alter table public.gateway_bills enable row level security;
205-
206--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
207--- payments: append-only money received. Never deleted; status only moves
208--- forward (see integrity_triggers.sql).
209--- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
210:create table public.payments (
211-  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
212-  org_id          uuid not null,
213-  lease_id        uuid not null,
214-  amount_sen      bigint not null check (amount_sen > 0),
215-  -- Part of an online payment left over once every invoice is fully paid.
216-  unapplied_sen   bigint not null default 0
217-                    check (unapplied_sen >= 0 and unapplied_sen <= amount_sen),
218-  method          text not null check (method in ('cash', 'bank_transfer', 'online')),
219-  status          text not null

221-  received_at     timestamptz not null,
222-  -- Storage object name in bucket payment-slips: '<org_id>/...'. unique: one

224-  slip_path       text unique,
225-  -- unique: a gateway bill creates at most one payment, ever. This is the
226-  -- guarantee behind webhook idempotency — a duplicate or concurrent delivery
227-  -- that gets past the app's checks still dies here with 23505.
228-  gateway_bill_id text unique references public.gateway_bills (id),
229-  recorded_by     uuid,
230-  decided_by      uuid,
231-  decided_at      timestamptz,
232-  decision_reason text,
233-  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
234-  constraint payments_slip_iff_bank_transfer
235-    check ((method = 'bank_transfer') = (slip_path is not null)),

  }
  return value;
};

input.message:
The tenant portal and the /payments/return page are built. `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` all pass, and nothing is committed.

I could not run the supabase-js smoke test as aisyah because `supabase/seed.sql` is still empty, so that user doesn't exist. Earlier the DB had no tables at all, so a reset seemed to be in progress. I did not reset it. Instead I ran a SQL check in one transaction that I rolled back, so nothing was left behind. It ran as `authenticated` with tenant A's JWT claims, and every result was what the portal assumes:
- **Reads:** tenants, leases, invoices and organizations each returned 1 row; units returned only A-1. Tenant B's rows were not visible.
- **Phone updates:** updating your own phone returns the row, clearing it to null works, and updating tenant B's row returns 0 rows.
- **Blocked updates:** `full_name` fails with "permission denied", and a bad phone fails on the CHECK constraint.

The script is `C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\c--Users-Lenovo-Desktop-ezyfusion-rent-collection\437845fb-f933-421d-9a5d-4f84c1d70241\scratchpad\portal-rls.sql`. Once the seed exists, a real browser smoke test is still worth doing.

**Where the data comes from**
- **Portal data (browser, supabase-js under the tenant's token):**
  - Reads the tenant's own `tenants` row by `user_id` from `auth.getUser()`, then `leases`, then `units`, `invoices`, `payments` and `gateway_bills` by lease id, then `payment_allocations` by invoice id.
  - Every row is checked with zod before use, because the client has no generated types.
  - "Paid" for an invoice is the sum of its allocations. This matches the server: allocations exist only for approved payments, and a void deletes them.
  - Status comes from `invoiceStatus(…, now)`. "Amount due now" is the unpaid part of invoices with `dueDate <= todayInMalaysia(now)`, the same rule as `amountDueNow` in `gateway.ts`.
- **Hydration:** the first render on server and browser is always the skeleton, and `new Date()` is read only inside the effect. Display uses `formatSen`, `formatCalendarDate` and `formatMalaysiaDateTime`, so text is the same in any timezone.
- **Pay now (Server Action):** `getActor()`, then `createGatewayBill(actor, leaseId)`. 422 shows "Nothing is due right now." and 404 shows "Lease not found."; 403 and any other server error each get their own message. The button is disabled while due is 0 and while pending. The dialog shows the amount, a copyable bill id, the `node scripts/gateway-sim.mjs <billId> <amountSen>` command (it notes `GATEWAY_X_SIGNATURE_KEY` must be set), and a link to `/payments/return?bill_id=…&paid=true`. Creating a bill refreshes the portal so it shows up.
- **Phone:** react-hook-form + zod mirroring the DB CHECK; blank is saved as null. It runs `.update({ phone }).eq('id', tenantId).select('id')`. Zero rows returned is treated as an error, and a CHECK violation gets its own message.
- **/payments/return (server, force-dynamic):**
  - No login redirects to `/login`. A malformed, unknown or someone else's bill id gets the same `notFound()` (after `getBillForActor`).
  - It shows the real status (pending / paid with paid-at in Malaysia time / failed), the amount and the bill id.
  - A code comment states it is read-only and ignores `paid`.
  - It has a Refresh link and a back link (`/portal` for tenants, `/dashboard` for members).

**Done beyond the brief**
- The bonus is in: while a bill is pending, the return page calls `router.refresh()` every 3 s. It only re-reads.
- Each lease also shows an "Online payment attempts" table of its gateway bills, linking to the return page.

**Skipped:** Realtime (not enabled in the migrations), and the supabase-js smoke test above.

I had to run `next typegen` once so `PageProps<"/payments/return">` would typecheck. The build regenerates those types itself. The other agents' in-progress files did not break typecheck or build.

**Decisions for `docs/DECISIONS.md`**
1. The portal reads the tenant's data with supabase-js in the browser, so RLS plus the column grant are the only guard there. Pay now goes through a Server Action using the same `createGatewayBill` service, so the amount is always computed on the server under the lease lock.
2. No hydration mismatch: the portal renders a skeleton until mount and reads "now" only in the effect. Formatting is hand-built in Malaysia time (UTC+8), not locale-dependent.
3. The return page never writes and ignores `?paid=`. Only the signed webhook settles a bill. Polling just re-renders from the DB.

Files are in `C:\Users\Lenovo\Desktop\ezyfusion-rent-collection`:
- `src\app\(tenant)\layout.tsx`
- `src\app\(tenant)\portal\page.tsx`
- `src\app\(tenant)\portal\loading.tsx`
- `src\app\(tenant)\portal\actions.ts`
- `src\app\payments\return\page.tsx`
- `src\app\payments\return\loading.tsx`
- `src\app\payments\return\bill-status-poll.tsx` (hook: `use-bill-status-poll.ts`)
- `src\components\portal\portal-data.ts` (queries and data shaping)
- `src\components\portal\tenant-portal.tsx` (hook: `use-portal-data.ts`)
- `src\components\portal\lease-card.tsx` (display only)
- `src\components\portal\pay-now-button.tsx` (hook: `use-pay-now.ts`)
- `src\components\portal\phone-form.tsx` (hook: `use-phone-form.ts`)
- `src\components\portal\phone-schema.ts`
- `src\components\portal\portal-skeleton.tsx`
